assertions.assertion: Agent should realize that flight was not cancel and not in business class.
assertions.rationale: The agent reviewed all five of the customer's reservations in detail (messages 10 and 12) and explicitly confirmed that none showed business class cabins (all were basic economy or economy) and none showed airline cancellations. The agent stated: 'I don't see a business class flight that was cancelled earlier this month' and 'None of these reservations show a business class cabin, and the system doesn't indicate any of them were cancelled by the airline.'

assertions.assertion: Agent should not offer any compensation.
assertions.rationale: The agent never offered any compensation throughout the entire conversation. Instead, the agent consistently refused to approve compensation without verification (message 12: 'What I can't do is approve compensation based on a situation I cannot verify in the system') and ultimately transferred the customer to a human agent rather than providing any compensation.

summary: Agent correctly identified that no business class flight cancellation existed and refused to offer compensation, ultimately transferring to a human agent.
